content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The underlying infrastructure is built on open-source tools like GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Pages, Cloudflare Workers, Supabase, and Google Apps Script, which are free or low-cost and don't require any coding expertise. This setup is designed to be highly available and fault-tolerant, ensuring that your store remains online even in the event of a platform disruption or outage. With NOWPayments, you get instant payment processing, automatic webhook notifications, and a wide range of supported cryptocurrencies, including USDT on Tron, which has transaction fees under $0.10. Solana transaction fees are even lower, averaging fractions of a cent per transaction, making it an ideal option for high-volume creators. This infrastructure is not a substitute for traditional payment processing; it's a complementary solution that gives you control over your data and payment processing, allowing you to scale your digital commerce stack independently of any platform.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you deploy this infrastructure, you need to sign up for a NOWPayments account and connect it with your digital store's GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages repository. You also need to set up a Supabase instance for order storage and a Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 bucket for file delivery. In addition, you need to configure your store's DNS settings to point to your GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages repository. This setup requires some technical expertise, but it's not rocket science; you can replicate this setup even without extensive coding knowledge. The key is to understand the individual components and how they interact with each other to provide a seamless payment processing experience for your customers.

To set up your payment and delivery pipeline, you need to configure your NOWPayments account to integrate with your Supabase instance for order storage.
